part.name: Cross-arm clamp and pivot assembly
part.description: Assembly-like mechanical model comprising two separate elongated crossing arms and a third central rounded-square clamp/pivot component. Each arm is a distinct CAD solid with end bores, transverse connection holes, a central pivot bore, and rounded transition geometry. The central solid provides opposed support plates and a collar-reinforced through bore that aligns the crossing members. Functional intent is inferred from geometry and rendered views.
part.symmetry_note: The model is centered near the CAD origin. SOLID 1 is approximately symmetric about the central x-z planes, while SOLID 2 has opposed rounded-square plate structures on opposite sides of the crossing arms. Repeated paired holes, end bores, and plate structures are present. SOLID 0 is oblique in the x-z plane and is not rotationally periodic about the central axis.

semantic_orientation.description: No unique human-semantic front, back, top, or bottom is established by the geometry. The assembly is most reliably described by the crossing-arm plane, the central pivot axis, and the opposed clamp plates. CAD camera labels are therefore not converted into human-semantic sides.
